title: 第1091章 令人不安的天武域第1090章 举世皆敌
lines: 手拿烙铁的强者刚刚转身，便是看见并排而立的萧羽和剑无名。
“老二，这是萧羽！和那个剑瞎子！”
天境强者提醒的同时，一把扔掉了手中的刑具，一柄长枪出现在手中，迅速的拉开了和萧羽的两人的距离。
“剑瞎子？”剑无名皱了皱眉头，他很不喜欢这个称呼。
萧羽旁若无人的向前走去，“无名，这个只是一位天境二重天，交给你了！”
萧羽的话音刚刚落下，矗立在那里的老二便是直直的向后倒去，他的眉心当中一道渗血剑痕。
那位天境而冲天的强者瞬间转身，同时一枪向着空间壁障划去，出手干净而利落，显然他的战斗经验非常的丰富，一连串逃跑的动作叹为观止。
剑无名手中的长剑一抖，一道剑芒一闪而逝，在他跨入空间裂缝的瞬间没入其后脑当中，这位天境二重天的强者，一头便是栽了进去，空间缓缓闭合。
萧羽怔了怔，无奈道：“无名，你这样有些浪费，天境强者我有用。”
剑无名点点头，“下次，我会注意的。”
“族长......我们没给天武大陆丢人。”猿族的战士看着萧羽，咧了咧嘴。
看着周围数名已经被折磨的不成样子的妖族战士，萧羽的鼻子一酸，灵力一震便是将缚于他们身上的枷锁震碎。
“兄弟们，你们受苦了！”萧羽轻声道。
“剩下的事情交给我们。”萧羽伸手一挥便是将他们送入识海世界当中疗伤去了。
“老大！”剑无名来萧羽身边，语气当中带着森冷的杀意。
“等我一会，去下一个地方。”萧羽的平静，但是任谁都听得出来，现在他的就是一座即将爆发的火山。
“我们现在怎么办？现在能够确定的的是对我们下手的绝对不是魔界的人，而是萧羽那个小子。”
王德志气愤的道，短短几十天的时间，他们已经损失了上百万的人手，虽然现在还没有到伤筋动骨的程度，但是长久以他九霄宇宙必然衰败，要知道他们现在可是什么好处也没有捞到，反而白白折损不少的人手。
而且九霄宇宙的内部已经出现了不满的声音。
“王德志，你有什么好抱怨的，要知道顾盟主早就让大家不要私自行动，将所有人都集中起来，为什么你的人迟迟不动？”曲战穹冷笑。
“曲战穹你什么意思，你有什么资格说风凉话？”王德志怒气冲冲的看向曲战穹。
“什么意思？你的那些小心思，在座的谁不清楚？”王德志毫不客气的回瞪。
叶雨楠手中拿着一把精致的匕首，一边打磨着自己的指甲，一边不嫌事大的道：“你二人在此争执有什么用，要不你们出去比试一场？”
“够了！”顾北桥实在看不下去了。
“王德志，你立刻将你九霄宇宙的强者召回，集中到一处，否则的话再出现什么问题，就不要在这里抱怨了。”
王德志看了一眼脸色难看的顾北桥，最终什么也没有说，重新坐了下来。
content_en:
The strong man holding the soldering iron just turned around and saw Xiao Yu and Jian Wuming standing side by side.
"Second brother, this is Xiao Yu! And that blind swordsman!"
At the same time as the reminder, the strong man from Heaven threw away the instrument of torture in his hand, a spear appeared in his hand, and quickly opened the distance between Xiao Yu and Xiao Yu.
"Sword blind man?" Jian Wuming frowned, he didn't like this title very much.
Xiao Yu walked forward as if there was no one around, "Wu Ming, this is just a second-level Heaven Realm, I leave it to you!"
As soon as Xiao Yu finished speaking, the old man standing there fell straight back, with a bloody sword mark between his eyebrows.
"Escape!"
The soaring strong man in the heavenly realm turned around in an instant, and at the same time fired a shot at the space barrier. His shot was clean and sharp. It was obvious that he had very rich combat experience, and his series of escape movements were breathtaking.
The long sword in Jian Wuming's hand shook, and a sword light flashed away. The moment he stepped into the space crack, it sank into the back of his head. This strong man of the second level of heaven fell into it, and the space slowly closed.
Xiao Yu was stunned and said helplessly: "Wu Ming, it's a bit wasteful for you to do this. I can be useful to those who are powerful in the heaven realm."
Jian Wuming nodded, "I will pay attention next time."
"Clan leader... we have not brought shame to the Tianwu Continent." The warrior of the ape tribe looked at Xiao Yu and grinned.
Looking at the several demon warriors around him who had been tortured into disgrace, Xiao Yu's nose felt sore, and his spiritual power shattered the shackles bound to them.
"Brothers, you have suffered!" Xiao Yu said softly.
"Leave the rest to us." Xiao Yu waved his hand and sent them into the world of sea of ​​consciousness to heal.
"Boss!" Jian Wuming came to Xiao Yu's side with a cold murderous intent in his tone.
"Wait for me for a while and go to the next place." Xiao Yu said calmly, but anyone could tell that now he was a volcano about to erupt.
...
"What should we do now? What is certain now is that the person who attacked us is definitely not someone from the demon world, but that kid Xiao Yu."
Wang Dezhi said angrily, in just a few dozen days, they have lost millions of manpower. Although it has not yet reached the point of breaking out of their muscles and bones, in the long run, Jiuxiao Universe will inevitably decline. You must know that they have not gained any benefits now, but have lost a lot of manpower in vain.
Moreover, voices of dissatisfaction have already appeared within Jiuxiao Universe.
"Wang Dezhi, what do you have to complain about? You know that Alliance Leader Gu has long asked everyone not to act privately and to gather everyone together. Why are your people so slow to move?" Qu Zhanqiong sneered.
"Qu Zhanqiong, what do you mean? What qualifications do you have to make sarcastic remarks?" Wang Dezhi looked at Qu Zhanqiong angrily.
"What do you mean? Who here doesn't know your little thoughts?" Wang Dezhi glared back unceremoniously.
Ye Yunan held an exquisite dagger in his hand, polishing his nails, and said calmly: "What's the point of you two arguing here? Why don't you go out and compete?"
"That's enough!" Gu Beiqiao couldn't stand it anymore.
"Wang Dezhi, please immediately recall the strong men from your Jiuxiao Universe and gather them in one place. Otherwise, if there are any problems again, don't complain here."
Wang Dezhi glanced at Gu Beiqiao, who looked ugly, and finally sat down again without saying anything.
